decisions.reason: A cobot loading system launched in 2024 is a strategic automation add-on for the firm's CNC milling machines, so a German machinery maker would give it several years to build sales rather than drop it after one year.
A dual-table loading system is a low-cost accessory that extends the core machine portfolio and meets customer demand for productivity, so keeping it makes sense.
The dispensing machine has its own product page and won a Red Dot Design Award in 2024, which signals strong commitment and market visibility, making withdrawal very unlikely.
